algorithm: Convolutional Neural Network (TensorFlow/Keras) — 3 Conv2D+BatchNorm+MaxPool blocks, trained from scratch (no pretrained weights, given no GPU/network access to pretrained model hubs in this build environment)
training_data_type: Real EuroSAT dataset (Helber et al. 2019) — Sentinel-2 RGB imagery, 27,000 labeled 64x64 patches across 10 land-use/land-cover classes
data_license: MIT (dataset), imagery from Copernicus Sentinel-2 (free and open under EU law)
known_limitation: Trained from scratch on a single CPU core in this build environment, not fine-tuned from a pretrained ImageNet/remote-sensing backbone as the original EuroSAT paper's best models were (which reached 98.57% using pretrained deep CNNs). This is a real, honestly-reported accuracy for a from-scratch model under real compute constraints, not the paper's benchmark number.
